attendance.title: Attendance Analysis
attendance.description: Import records from the external time-clock system and view monthly attendance statistics per employee
attendance.importDescription: Upload the .xls file exported from the external time-clock system (must include department / account / name / shift, and daily clock-in/out). The system matches each row to an employee using the "Attendance Account" set in Employee Management. Since the date headers (e.g. "07-01") don't include a year, specify the year below.

leave.title: Leave Type Distribution
leave.description: Statistics on the proportion of each leave type used
leave.importDescription: Upload the "Leave Records" .xls file exported from the external time-clock system (must include account / leave type / leave start and end time). The system matches each row to an employee using the "Attendance Account" set in Employee Management, to fill in historical leave data from before the digital leave application feature went live. This does not affect leave balances or the approval workflow.
